title: DUMA-Bench: A Dual-Control Multi-Agent Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agent Security
abstract: arXiv:2609.24662v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based agents increasingly operate in environments where they interact with users, tools, and external systems. Yet most security evaluations assume passive users and static control, ignoring the interactive dynamics that shape real agent behavior. We introduce \textbf{DUMA-Bench}, a benchmark and evaluation protocol for measuring agent security under \emph{dual-control} interaction, where both the agent and the user can influence the shared environment state. DUMA-Bench extends $\tau^2$-bench ~\cite{barres2025tau} with adversarial environments covering eight vulnerability classes, including RAG poisoning, cross-agent manipulation, and unsafe output handling. We evaluate \textbf{14 models from five model families} (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Z.ai) across eight domains and multiple user-behavior regimes. translated_title: DUMA-Bench：一个用于评估LLM智能体安全性的双控制多智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的智能体越来越多地在与用户、工具和外部系统交互的环境中运行。然而，大多数安全评估都假设用户是被动的、控制是静态的，忽略了塑造真实智能体行为的交互动态。我们提出了DUMA-Bench，这是一个用于衡量双控制交互下智能体安全性的基准测试和评估协议，在这种交互中，智能体和用户都可以影响共享的环境状态。DUMA-Bench在τ²-bench的基础上进行了扩展，增加了涵盖八类漏洞的对抗性环境，包括RAG投毒、跨智能体操纵和不安全的输出处理。我们在八个领域和多种用户行为模式下评估了来自五个模型家族（OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek、Qwen和Z.ai）的14个模型。在实验中，引入双控制交互使攻击成功率从26.9%提升至……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出DUMA-Bench，一个在“双控制”交互（用户与智能体均可影响共享环境状态）下评估LLM智能体安全性的多智能体基准，涵盖八类漏洞，实验表明双控制交互使攻击成功率从26.9%大幅上升。
